name: DlightRAG · the browser channel reported an error
message: the browser channel reported an error; this window saw {{value}}. front-end errors reach the stack as error spans from dlightrag-web: the SDK's default `onerror` capture raises one per uncaught browser error, and a fetch that failed at the network layer raises another. the log branch stays because it is the right signal if console capture is ever turned on, and no web log record has ever been exported, so today the span branch is the one that fires. open the span for the stack trace.

chartConfig.name: front-end error records
chartConfig.sqlTemplate:
SELECT count() AS front_end_errors
FROM (
  SELECT Timestamp
  FROM otel_logs
  WHERE ServiceName = 'dlightrag-web'
    AND (lower(SeverityText) IN ('error', 'fatal') OR SeverityNumber >= 17)
    AND $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT Timestamp
  FROM otel_traces
  WHERE ServiceName = 'dlightrag-web'
    AND StatusCode = 'Error'
    AND $__timeFilter_ms(Timestamp)
)
